sql: select count(*) from approval_queue where object_type = 'intel_topic' and block = 'intel' and status = 'pending' and created_by = 'agent:intel_bulletin'

select (select count(*) from approval_queue where object_type = 'intel_topic') = (select count(*) from (select t from intel_items, unnest(topics) t where t in ('sam', 'tpbvsk', 'gioi_tre', 'quang_cao', 'doi_thu') group by t having count(*) >= 2) x)
select string_agg(regexp_replace(object_id, '^day-[0-9]{8}-', ''), ',' order by object_id) from approval_queue where object_type = 'intel_topic'
select count(*) from approval_queue where object_type = 'intel_topic' and (payload || ' ' || title) ~* 'https?://|www\.|tin-thu-it|Thử IT'
select count(*) from approval_queue where object_type = 'intel_topic' and object_id like '%phap_ly'
